subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The fox said to the tiger, “Why are you moving round the jungle?” The tiger said, “I am searching for a prey for lunch.” “What are you doing in a pensive mood sitting under the tree?” “I am thinking about our future in the jungle” said the fox. The tiger said, “I am hearing the sound of cutting down trees”
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech The fox asked the tiger why he was moving round the jungle. The tiger replied that he was searching for a prey for lunch. Then the tiger asked the fox what he was doing in a pensive mood sitting under the tree. The fox replied that he was thinking abour their future in the jungle. The tiger said that he was hearing the sound of cutting down trees.
